skill.name: skill-installer
skill.description: Install Codex skills into $CODEX_HOME/skills from curated OpenAI skill lists or specific GitHub repository paths.
skill.summary: Installs curated or GitHub-hosted Codex skills into the local Codex skills directory.
skill.author: openai

security_audit.summary: The confirmed findings are expected for a skill installer: GitHub network access, optional GitHub token use, git subprocess fallback, and filesystem writes under CODEX_HOME. Several static hits are false positives from Markdown backticks, validation errors, repository paths, and a guarded zip extraction call.

remediation.issue: Unreviewed skills can be installed from arbitrary GitHub paths.
remediation.suggestion: Show a clear warning before installing non-curated skills and recommend reviewing SKILL.md before restart.

remediation.issue: Install sources are not pinned or verified by default.
remediation.suggestion: Encourage users to pin refs to commits and consider adding checksum or provenance display before copying files.

remediation.issue: GitHub tokens are read from the environment for private repository access.
remediation.suggestion: Document that tokens should be least-privilege and never logged or shared with untrusted repositories.

content.value_statement: Teams need a reliable way to add Codex skills without manual copying. This skill lists curated skills and installs selected GitHub skill folders into the local Codex setup.
actual_capabilities: Lists curated skills from the OpenAI skills repository.
Marks curated skills that are already installed locally.
Installs one or more skill folders from a GitHub repository path.
Supports public downloads and git sparse checkout fallback.
Uses optional GitHub credentials for private repository access.
Installs skills into CODEX_HOME or the default Codex skills directory.
limitations: Only GitHub repository sources are supported by the helper scripts.
The installer does not audit installed skill content for safety.
Existing destination skill folders are not overwritten automatically.
Network access and git credentials may be required for private repositories.

use_cases.title: Browse Available Skills
use_cases.description: List curated skills and see which ones are already installed before choosing additions.

use_cases.title: Install Team Skills
use_cases.description: Install approved internal skills from a private GitHub repository into a local Codex environment.

use_cases.title: Set Up Workstations
use_cases.description: Add multiple skill folders from one repository during developer environment setup.

prompt_templates.prompt: List the curated Codex skills that I can install and show which ones are already installed.

prompt_templates.prompt: Install the curated skill named documentation-helper into my Codex skills directory.

prompt_templates.prompt: Install the skill at github.com/example/tools/tree/main/skills/release-notes into my Codex skills directory.

prompt_templates.title: Install Private Team Skills
prompt_templates.prompt: Install skills/team-review and skills/deploy-checks from my private GitHub repository using the existing credentials.

output_examples.input: Install the release-notes skill from a GitHub path.
output_examples.output: Installed release-notes to the local Codex skills directory. Restart Codex to pick up new skills.

output_examples.input: Install a skill that already exists locally.
output_examples.output: The installer reports that the destination already exists and stops without overwriting the local skill.

best_practices: Review SKILL.md before installing skills from non-curated repositories.
Pin GitHub refs to stable commits when installing team-managed skills.
Restart Codex after installation so newly installed skills are loaded.
anti_patterns: Do not install skills from unknown repositories without reviewing their instructions.
Do not use broad GitHub tokens when a read-only token is enough.
Do not assume an installed skill is active before restarting Codex.

faq.question: Where does this skill install files?
faq.answer: It installs skill folders into CODEX_HOME/skills, or ~/.codex/skills when CODEX_HOME is not set.

faq.question: Can it install private repository skills?
faq.answer: Yes. It can use existing git credentials or optional GitHub token environment variables.

faq.question: Does it overwrite existing skills?
faq.answer: No. The installer stops if the destination skill folder already exists.

faq.question: Does it validate skill safety?
faq.answer: No. It checks that SKILL.md exists, but users should review skill content before restart.

faq.question: Can Claude or Claude Code use this report?
faq.answer: The marketplace content references Claude and Claude Code compatibility, but the scripts install Codex skill files.

faq.question: What happens after installation?
faq.answer: The user should restart Codex so the newly installed skills are discovered and loaded.
